content.text:
This figure is from FAA-H-8083-30A, Aviation Maintenance Technician Handbook: General, chapter 2 (regulations, maintenance forms, records, and publications). Its caption: "Figure 2-16. Type certificate.".
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows a blank FAA Type Certificate form with a large diagonal “SAMPLE” watermark across the page.

Printed text:

- This certificate, and the Type Certificate Data Sheet which is a part hereof, shall remain in effect until surrendered, suspended, revoked, or a termination date is otherwise established by the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration.
- Date of application:
